questions.question: During the battle with the Philistines, King Saul put a curse on any soldier who did what before evening?
In the forest, Saul's son Jonathan walked past some honey and did not taste it. True or false?
When Saul learned his son Jonathan had tasted the honey, how did Saul answer him?

answers.text: He swore Jonathan would surely die
He said the oath did not count for Jonathan
He told the priest to decide it

questions.question: Why did the people tell King Saul that his son Jonathan must never die?

answers.text: He brought a great deliverance for Israel
He promised never to do it again
He offered a sacrifice for his sin
